Who We Are
Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build, and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips-the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world-like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next-generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.At Applied Materials, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go.

As a mechanical engineer, you'll leverage your strong foundation in physics, mathematics, and materials science to process and resolve mechanical problems; design and implement custom mechanical tooling and associated processes; and enable the handling, assembly, and disassembly of parts, components, sub-assemblies, and final assemblies throughout the product life cycle. You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and modifying mechanical engineering layouts, schematics, and specifications. You will oversee manufacturing and installation processes, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations, and you'll coordinate the procurement and assembly of mechanical components and equipment for design projects, identifying sources of critical parts and subsystems to resolve technical issues. We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) with a strong foundation in precision machining and design for manufacturability. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on shop floor experience in high-tech manufacturing environments and a deep understanding of mechanical design principles, including GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead mechanical design projects from concept through to product release.

Develop designs optimized for manufacturability and cost efficiency.

Apply advanced GD&T principles and perform tolerance stack analyses.

Collaborate closely with vendors and manufacturing teams to ensure design feasibility, quality, and cost effectiveness.

Create detailed 3D models and engineering drawings using CAD tools.

Support prototype development and testing, incorporating feedback into design iterations.

Participate in design reviews and cross-functional team meetings.

Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with engineering standards.

Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or related field.

Minimum 5 years of combined practical and theoretical experience in mechanical design and manufacturing.

Strong expertise in precision machining and familiarity with a wide range of manufacturing processes, including

Turning, milling, welding, electro-erosion, polishing, etc.

Proven experience in design for manufacturability and cost optimization.

Excellent knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and tolerance stack-up.

Hands-on experience in high-tech manufacturing environments, preferably involving precision mechanics and diverse materials.

Demonstrated success in vendor collaboration and project completion to product release.

Fluent in English, with good proficiency in German.

Familiarity with ISO standards and quality systems.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

€70,400.00 - €96,800.00 Preferred Skills:

Experience with PLM systems and engineering change processes.

(Senior) Research Associate - Protein Science (gn)
Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software
You are a well-organized, reliable team player with a hands-on mentality and strong communication skills
You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment
You are proficient in English, both spoken and written
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with around 45 employees, driven by a shared purpose: to transform cancer treatment for patients. We work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes, in a welcoming and trusting environment where real progress comes from working together. What you can expect from us:

Work that matters: your work feeds directly into our pipeline of cancer immunotherapies, from multifunctional antibodies to T cell engagers on their way to the clinic
Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
On top of that: 30 days of vacation, flexible working hours, and support for a job bike or Deutschlandticket

jobs.description:
We welcome applications via our website from 25 August - 07 October 2026.

The International Max Planck Research School for Molecules of Life (IMPRS-ML) offers fully funded PhD student positions in the areas of biochemistry, structural biology, biophysics, cell biology, systems biology, and computational biology. We are looking for outstanding graduates from all over the world to join our network of passionate young scientists in Munich. CURRICULUM & TRAINING
IMPRS-ML offers high-level scientific training in a dynamic and international research environment with state-of-the-art facilities to doctoral researchers aiming for successful careers in science. Our comprehensive curriculum allows our students to tailor their learning to their interests, requiring them to earn 25-30 ECTS through various activities. Seminars, summer schools, retreats, elective courses, and participation in international conferences supplement their laboratory work.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
The strongest asset of our graduate program is our vivid and international research community. IMPRS-ML brings together two renowned Max Planck Institutes, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry (MPIB) and the Max Planck Institute for Biological Intelligence (MPI-BI), as well as two leading partner universities, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), to deliver first-class training for the world’s most promising young scientists. Our graduate school comprises more than 250 PhD students from 40+ countries as well as 35+ distinguished and internationally recognised faculty members.
Applicants should hold an MSc (or equivalent degree) with a strong background in biological sciences, biochemistry, biophysics, biotechnology or a related discipline.
Outstanding applicants with a 4-years BSc hons (or equivalent degree) may be eligible to apply depending on the degree awarding country.

For more information, eligibility criteria and online application please visit our website:  https://imprs-ml.mpg.de/
A structured PhD program created by Munich-based Max Planck Institutes and Universities with English as the main language

Individual supervision and mentoring by world-leading scientists

Paid PhD positions and full funding for international and German students, with no tuition fees and additional funding for scientific training
An individual career development program, a wide range of methodology courses and soft skills workshops

Administrative support and guidance for national and international students

jobs.occupation: Head of Structures (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced and passionate Head of Structures to lead and further develop our growing structures team.In this role, you will take overall technicalresponsibility for the structural development of our VTOL aircrafts, fro initial concepts and structural architecture through detailed design, analysis, manufacturing support and structural testing.You will define the structural strategy, make key technical decisions and ensure that lightweight, robust, manufacturable and certifiable structures are developed inline with the overall aircraft and programme objectives. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of structural design and analysis engineers while remaining closely involved in design reviews, prototype manufacturing, aircraft integration and structural testing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• You lead and further develop the structures team and take overall technical responsibility for the aircraft structure, from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing, testing and flight operations
• You define and maintain the structural architecture, load paths, design principles and material concepts and lead the development of primary and secondary structures, including fuselage, wings, empennage, propulsion-supporting structures, landing gear interfaces and system installations
• You define structural requirements, verification methods, test strategies and acceptance criteria and coordinate analyses covering strength, stiffness, stability, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration and dynamic behaviour
• You plan, review and support coupon, component, subassembly and full-scale structural tests and ensure compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements, certification objectives and internal development processes
• You coordinate closely with Loads, Flight Physics, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Testing, Certification and Quality to develop lightweight, robust, manufacturable and integrated structural solutions.
• You review and approve structural concepts, calculations, drawings, reports and test documentation and manage structural risks, deviations, design changes and corrective actions
• You actively support prototype manufacturing, structural assembly, aircraft integration, ground and flight testing and the resolution of practical issues, structural findings, damage or failures directly on the hardware
• You establish and continuously improve engineering processes, methods, tools and documentation standards and support the selection and coordination of external development and manufacturing partners
• You translate the structural development roadmap into clear priorities and responsibilities and support the growth of the team through recruiting, onboarding, mentoring and technical development

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Several years of professional experience in aircraft structures, including responsibility for structural design, analysis or verification, form part of your background
• Strong experience in the development of lightweight aircraft structures from initial concept through detailed design and testing is something you bring to the table
• You have extensive knowledge of composite, metallic and sandwich structures, including relevant manufacturing and joining technologies
• Structural mechanics, load paths, finite element analysis, strength, stability, fatigue and structural testing form part of your technical expertise
• You bring strong hands-on experience in the manufacturing, assembly, modification, repair or testing of aircraft structures and prototypes
• You are comfortable working directly with prototypes and hardware and enjoy resolving practical structural and integration challenges together with the workshop and test teams
• Leading a multidisciplinary engineering team while remaining technically and practically involved is something you are capable of
• You are able to make technical decisions and balance weight, performance, safety, manufacturability, cost and schedule
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with a structured and pragmatic working style
• Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Experience with the structural development of VTOL aircraft, helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, UAVs or other lightweight aerospace systems is a plus
• Knowledge of EASA regulations and guidance material for UAS and eVTOL development, such as SORA, SC Light-UAS or SC-VTOL, is a valuable asset
• Experience with structural compliance demonstration, certification documentation and coordination with certification authorities adds to your profile
• Familiarity with finite element and design tools such as ANSYS, Nastran, Abaqus, Siemens NX or comparable software strengthens your application
• Experience with composite manufacturing processes, bonded joints and mechanically fastened joints is an advantage
• Planning and conducting structural test campaigns, from test definition and readiness through execution and data evaluation, is something you have done before
• Experience in building up or growing an engineering team, including hiring and mentoring, rounds out your qualifications
• German language skills are an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company ev

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

In this role, you'll apply your technical expertise in high-performance liquid chromatography and consultative sales approach to identify opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and deliver solutions that enable groundbreaking scientific advances. We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.
Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the Glassomer technology with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners.
A particular focus will be placed on the development of photocurable and thermoplastic silica nanocomposites, optimization of their processing behavior, and tailoring of the glass composition to improve thermal stability during fiber fabrication. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Developing novel photocurable silica nanocomposites for high-resolution additive manufacturing of microstructured glass preforms.
Formulating highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigating particle dispersion, rheological properties, curing behavior, and processing windows of nanocomposite systems.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: Stereolithography-based 3D printing, Extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

Master’s degree/Bachelor’s degree/Studies in Chemistry, Material Science or related subjects
Profound knowledge of polymer chemistry, material science and processing is required
Knowledge of glass science, ceramic processing or polymer extrusion are/is beneficial.
Excellent academic track record
Excellent English skills in reading and writing
You should be a team player with ambitions who can conduct research projects independently
You should be able to structure and document your work properly
